title: Assessing pseudobulk DE adequacy with seny
text: assessAll() chains layers — pseudobulk setup, design/confounding (layer 1), pseudobulk quality (layer 2), variance structure sensitivity (layer 4) — returns one row per comparison. comparison table carries layer-2 cell-quality metrics alongside call. cells_cond_cor correlation log cells-per-sample condition; cells_ratio smaller group median larger; expected_recall share true effects target size test expected detect (mean per-gene power target), drives Adequate / Underpowered call. non-adequate call explains : CD4 T clean (Adequate). CD8 T far fewer cells condition B, cell-count imbalance tracks condition; seny reports reason, call stays Adequate edgeR voom remain calibrated imbalance. DESeq2 loses FDR control , method = "deseq2" comparison Caution: NK high -donor variance modest cell count, genes detectable target effect (Underpowered).
code: res <- assessAll(sce, sample = "donor", group = "condition",                  annotations = "cell_type", targetLFC = 1) #> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes #> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes #> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes cols <- c("cluster", "nA", "nB", "median_cells", "gini_cells", "cells_ratio",           "cells_cond_cor", "n_testable", "expected_recall", "call") knitr::kable(as.data.frame(res)[, cols], digits = 2, row.names = FALSE) d <- as.data.frame(res) for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {     cat(d$cluster[i], "->", as.character(d$call[i]), "::", d$reason[i], "\n") } #> CD4T -> Adequate :: adequate  #> CD8T -> Adequate :: cell-count imbalance correlated with condition (r -1.00, cutoff 0.50 at 24 samples; reported only: edgeR and voom stay calibrated)  #> NK -> Underpowered :: underpowered (expected recall 45% at log2FC 1) res_d <- assessAll(sce, sample = "donor", group = "condition",                    annotations = "cell_type", targetLFC = 1, method = "deseq2") as.character(res_d$call[res_d$cluster == "CD8T"]) #> [1] "Caution"

title: Assess every pseudobulk comparison end to end — assessAll
text: sce SingleCellExperiment::SingleCellExperiment SummarizedExperiment raw-count assay (non-negative integers). assay may base sparse matrix, --memory matrix DelayedMatrix HDF5-backed matrix (atlases beyond one sparse matrix's 2^31 nonzeros): checked summed block cells time (options(seny.block_cells = ...), default 1e5). sample Character scalar; colData column giving biological sample (donor) cell belongs . group Character scalar; colData column giving condition compared. annotations Character vector colData columns, clustering (annotation level) pseudobulk, e.g. c("cell_type_broad"). covariates Character vector colData columns carry candidate confounders. Default none. contrasts Optional list length-2 character vectors c(, B) naming group levels compare (B vs ). Default NULL: non-reference levels versus first level. minCells Integer; pseudobulks fewer contributing cells dropped. Default 10. aggregation Either "sum" (counts, negative-binomial model) "mean" (reserved limma path). Default "sum". assayName Name raw-count assay sce. Default "counts". method DE method whose variance model call match, passed estimateVariance(): "edgeR", "deseq2" "voom". "edgeR"/"deseq2" require aggregation = "sum"; aggregation = "mean" requires "voom". targetLFC Primary target absolute log2 fold-change driving call. power, fdr, pi1, alphaFixed Sensitivity settings passed estimateSensitivity(). thresholds list defaultThresholds(). thetaReps Subsample repeats cell-level theta fit, passed pbSetup(); 0 skips (call unchanged, variance decomposition NA). compReference Source per-cell subtype expression assessComposition(): "reference" (default) "pooled". BPPARAM BiocParallelParam object per-cluster theta estimation. Default BiocParallel::SerialParam().

text: Cluster share (every annotation level, reported ): cluster's share sample's cells, vs B, tested speckle::propeller (arcsin-square-root proportions, limma). cluster whose share shifts problem DE within , never changes call. Subtype shift within cluster (needs finer annotation nested one, see pbSetup()): propeller children's shares parent's cells, comparison's samples. Composition-sensitive genes (prospective): per gene, log2 fold change observed subtype shift alone produce parent's library-size-normalised pseudobulk, log2[(sum_k pB_k c_gk / sum_k pB_k L_k) / (sum_k pA_k c_gk / sum_k pA_k L_k)], p donor-averaged child shares, c_gk per-cell mean count gene g child k L_k child's per-cell library size. gene's power called DE shift-change (layer 4, comparison's per-gene alpha) comp_power; sum, exp_comp_deg, number DEGs shift alone expected produce, frac_comp_expected share testable genes. callComparisons() flags comparison Caution child's shift significant frac_comp_expected reaches thresholds$compFrac. Genes whose shift-change exceeds MDE (sensitive, counted n_comp_sensitive) reported , many genes modest power add many artefacts without clearing MDE, count understates risk (E6). Attribution observed parent DEGs (retrospective, reported ): gene method's test calls DE parent fdr labelled composition-driven (DE child comparison, shift-change sign explains least thresholds$compExplained observed change), within-child DE (DE least one child), mixed () unresolved (neither, child comparison fitted). Clusters without finer annotation nested get composition = "assessed"; parts 2-4 need two annotation levels.

what: Layer 4 (sensitivity): minimum detectable effect and power — estimateSensitivity
title: Layer 4 (sensitivity): minimum detectable effect and power — estimateSensitivity
text: variance fits (estimateVariance()), computes analytic standard error two-group log2 fold-change contrast per gene (SE^2 = 1/sum_A w + 1/sum_B w, w = 1/(1/mu + phi), phi dispersion condition design), minimum detectable effect target power FDR, power primary target effect. Summarises comparison's expected recall targetLFC: mean per-gene power target testable genes, .e. share true effects size test expected detect spread like testable genes. callComparisons() calls comparison Adequate expected recall reaches defaultThresholds()$sensitivity (0.5). OneK1K known injected effects tracked observed recall per comparison (slope 1.0), whereas sensitivity fraction (share genes whose MDE clears target target power, still reported) -predicts (E4c). Uncalibrated MVP (calibrate = FALSE).

what: Layer 4 (variance): null-model dispersion, decomposition and per-gene SE — estimateVariance
title: Layer 4 (variance): null-model dispersion, decomposition and per-gene SE — estimateVariance
text: every comparison, fits chosen DE method returns per-gene standard error two-group log2 fold-change contrast (used estimateSensitivity()). SE uses variance estimated condition design, user's test sees , evaluated condition-blind (null-model) fitted means. edgeR mirrors quasi-likelihood test: QL fit's NB dispersion gene's posterior QL dispersion (s2.post) top, voom SE carries limma's s2.post. Power always computed target effect, never observed one. null-model dispersion absorb real effects noise understate power exactly DE strong. variance decomposition stays condition-blind. count methods (edgeR, deseq2) also splits pseudobulk negative-binomial dispersion phi_total cell-heterogeneity term (theta/n, cell-level theta pbSetup()) -donor term phi_donor (moment estimate max(0, phi_total - theta*mean(1/n))), reports depth/cell/donor variance shares regime label. voom method uses limma's precision-weight variance model, NB decomposition (columns NA).
